pages.text: The pages keep to old houses: $(li)terrain$(li)biomes and controllers$(li)time and weather$(li)suns, moons, stars, and clouds$(li)sky anomalies and ambient particles$(li)creature laws$(li)landmarks$(li)colors and their targets$(li)stranger marks such as $(thing)Random$(), $(thing)Age Effect$(), $(thing)Curse Cleansing$(), and $(thing)Low Gravity$().

$(thing)Color pages$() speak in pairs. First the hue, then the vessel. $(c)Blue$() before $(c)Water$() stains the waters blue. The same order binds sky, fog, grass, foliage, ambient light, clouds, and fire or lava. A target consumes all waiting colors and uses the last.

$(thing)Biome pages$() may name one country, an evenly weighted list, or a pattern by which many countries take turns. Vanilla Distribution and Checkerboard are the two controllers. The calmest Ages I have walked were often the plainest: one biome, clearly chosen.

$(thing)Low Gravity$() stands alone. It sets the Age to 45% of ordinary gravity, softening falls and making every leap suspiciously heroic. It adds 22 instability, is inherited by lesser realms, and is not disabled by the instability-effects toggle.
